This is a Next.js project for generating digital name cards with QR code functionality that allows auto-saving contact information to smartphones.

## Project Features
- Digital business card creation with contact details
- QR code generation containing vCard data
- Auto-save functionality when QR codes are scanned on smartphones
- Responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Real-time preview of name cards
- Export options for digital sharing

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14 with TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- QR code generation libraries
- vCard format for contact data

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Follow Next.js 14 app router conventions
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Ensure QR codes generate proper vCard format for smartphone compatibility
- Focus on user experience for both card creation and mobile scanning
